query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valuations (
  id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  userId VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  propertyType VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  district VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  area INT NOT NULL,
  latitude TEXT,
  longitude TEXT,
  streetWidth INT,
  facingDirection VARCHAR(32),
  age INT,
  finishingQuality VARCHAR(32),
  amenities JSON,
  specialFeatures JSON,
  numberOfRooms INT,
  numberOfBathrooms INT,
  numberOfFloors INT,
  hasGarage BOOLEAN,
  hasGarden BOOLEAN,
  estimatedValue INT NOT NULL,
  pricePerSqm INT,
  confidenceScore INT NOT NULL,
  valuationMethod VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  marketTrend VARCHAR(32),
  comparables JSON,
  dataSources JSON,
  analysisDetails TEXT,
  reportUrl TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
